definitions.gloss: vacant room; unoccupied room; room available for rent
definitions.explanation: A room that is currently empty and not occupied, whether in an apartment building, hotel, or office building. Often seen on signs and in real estate listings.

examples.japanese: {空室|くうしつ}⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{空室|くうしつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ほとんど→ほとんど：00847_hotondo⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: There are hardly any vacant rooms in this apartment building.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦エリア→エリア：10726_eria⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{空室|くうしつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{埋|う}まって→埋まる：01897_umaru⟧しまう。
examples.english: In the popular area near the station, any vacancy is filled immediately.

notes:
Commonly seen on signs outside apartment buildings and in real estate advertisements. The opposite is ⟦{満室|まんしつ}→満室：15726_manshitsu⟧ (no vacancy, fully occupied).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {空室|くうしつ}あり (vacancy available)
- {空室|くうしつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (a vacancy opens up)
- {空室|くうしつ}⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧ (vacancy status)
- {空室|くうしつ}{率|りつ} (vacancy rate)

USAGE:
For hotels, {空室|くうしつ} refers to available rooms. In real estate, it refers to apartments or offices available for rent. The sign {空室|くうしつ} on a building means rooms are available, while ⟦{満室|まんしつ}→満室：15726_manshitsu⟧ means fully occupied.
